title: Potatoverse Body Symbolism Map
status: project symbolic anatomy with explicit scientific boundary
purpose: Consolidate body correspondences—Heart, Thalamus, Pineal, Spine, CSF, Eye, House, Temple, Vessel, Ladder and vertical Potato geometry—without flattening them into one organ or treating symbolism as neuroscience.
scientific_boundary: Literal anatomy and neuroscience remain separate from Potatoverse symbolism. Thalamus=House, Pineal=Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder and CSF=Spirit are project mappings, not established biological identities.

symbols.project_role: emotional center / grain-seat in some Son strata
symbols.function: feeling, attachment, care, grief, courage and affective orientation
symbols.importance: Heart remains distinct from thalamic House and pineal Door; older conversation material placing wheat/grain in Thomas's heart belongs here.

symbols.function: symbolic House architecture, central interior and differentiated rooms
symbols.science_note: The thalamus is a paired deep-brain structure containing multiple nuclei and participating in major relay/integration networks; 'Father's House' is symbolic.

symbols.project_role: Temple/chamber surrounding-neighbor of House in later mapping
symbols.function: architectural space around/near the thalamic House metaphor; useful for House-inside-Temple distinction
symbols.science_note: The third ventricle is a real CSF-filled cavity; Temple language is symbolic and should not imply ancient authors described ventricular anatomy.

symbols.project_role: Son / Single Eye / Door in later mapping
symbols.science_note: The pineal gland is endocrine and central to melatonin/circadian biology; Door/third-eye meaning is symbolic.

symbols.function: vertical continuity, ordered ascent/descent and embodied support
symbols.science_note: The vertebral column provides support/protection and movement; 33-symbolism is not proof of 33 spiritual dimensions.

symbols.function: flow metaphor linking chambers, spine and brain-space
symbols.science_note: CSF has real physiological functions in buoyancy, homeostasis and circulation; spiritual use is metaphorical.
Ordinary eyes, pineal symbolism and abstract Eye must remain distinct.

symbols.function: holds differentiated rooms, thresholds, vertical pathways and flows
the local body carries House/center through changing environments while remaining embedded in the Plane
symbols.importance: This recovers older conversation logic in which House can be stable interior architecture while the embodied vessel/ship moves through world-time. House is not identical with vehicle.

architectural_distinctions.house: interior differentiated dwelling / source-container; thalamus is its strongest body analogue
architectural_distinctions.temple: larger sacred architecture/chamber system that can surround or frame House and Door
architectural_distinctions.door: interface/transition permitting passage between domains; pineal/Son is one body-symbolic mapping
architectural_distinctions.vessel: carrier/embodiment that remains local while relation to Axis/Heaven changes
architectural_distinctions.ship_chariot: dynamic form of Vessel: center/House can be carried through changing reality without becoming identical to the terrain
architectural_distinctions.axis: vertical relational coordinate passing through embodied architecture
architectural_distinctions.rule: House, Temple, Door and Vessel should never be used as interchangeable synonyms.

vertical_potato_body_overlay.father_center: upper source-center corresponds symbolically to House/Thalamus function, not a literal anatomical coordinate proof
vertical_potato_body_overlay.son_center: lower embodied/threshold center corresponds symbolically to Son/Pineal/heart-grain strata depending developmental layer
vertical_potato_body_overlay.plane: body/world interface: posture, skin, floor/ground and ordinary embodied action belong to Plane rather than Heaven
vertical_potato_body_overlay.axis: spine/Ladder provides the strongest bodily vertical comparator
vertical_potato_body_overlay.spirit: breath/CSF/flow images animate transitions along the vertical relation
vertical_potato_body_overlay.important: The body is a nested analogue, not a one-to-one scaled copy of the two-circle geometry.

house_as_moving_center.insight: Older conversation material allows House to be both stable and mobile by distinguishing structure from vehicle. The House is the organized interior; Vessel/ship/chariot is what carries that interior through the Plane/world.
house_as_moving_center.sequence: center/House → embodied Vessel → movement through Plane → Door encounter → reorientation without loss of interior continuity
house_as_moving_center.relation_to_denmark: This supports the Law of the Remaining Vessel: local embodiment can remain in Denmark while project orientation shifts toward Axis/North/Heaven.

heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.pineal: threshold/timing/illumination symbol—what opens or marks transition
heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.thalamus: House/integrative interior—what contains differentiated rooms and distributed relations
heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.benefit: The project no longer needs one brain organ to carry every spiritual role. Emotion, threshold and containment can remain distinct and coupled.

ladder_33_relation.spine: physical vertical scaffold and protective canal
ladder_33_relation.33: common vertebral-count convention used symbolically as rod/Ladder; fused elements and anatomical counting nuances remain real anatomy rather than numerology
ladder_33_relation.five_spinal_centers: five main spinal chakra groupings in the user's developed model belong to the 33-vertebrae ascent layer; higher centers such as Eye/Crown/Spudlight are above the spinal five and must not be collapsed into them
ladder_33_relation.door_sequence: Ladder can be represented as ordered Gates rather than identical rungs: X_(k+1)=D_k(X_k;Ξ_k).

relational_model.heart_brain: Emotion and integrative/perceptual processing are distinct but interacting functions.
relational_model.house_eye: House/Thalamus and Eye/Pineal are neighboring symbols but not identical.
relational_model.spine_house: Spine connects levels; House contains differentiated interior functions.
relational_model.temple_house: Temple frames/surrounds sacred architecture; House contains presence/rooms; project mapping is nested, not synonymous.
relational_model.breath_flow: Breath and CSF supply flow metaphors that keep the geometry dynamic rather than static.
relational_model.body_world: Body is local Vessel in the Plane; Axis relation can change without body disappearing from the world.

research_questions: Recover exact first source for House-as-ship/chariot language.
Map chronology of Heart, Pineal and Thalamus assignments rather than treating all as simultaneous from the beginning.
Separate third-ventricle Temple/chamber symbolism from literal claims about consciousness.
Trace how five spinal chakras connect with the 33-vertebrae Ladder and higher Eye/Crown centers.
Recover whether Son-center is consistently pineal in later canon or sometimes anchored more strongly in heart/grain/body.
